rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked protocol website (JS-blocked), PR Newswire press release, and third-party aggregator pages. Four VBILL token contracts catalogued across all four chains. No audit PDFs, GitHub, or canonical deployments doc found.

protocol_metadata.about: VanEck Treasury Fund (VBILL) is a tokenized money-market fund launched in May 2025 in partnership with Securitize, offering qualified investors on-chain access to short-term U.S. Treasury obligations. Investors subscribe using USDC or USD and receive VBILL tokens pegged at $1.00, with daily yield accrued as new tokens. The fund operates across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Avalanche, and Solana with cross-chain interoperability via Wormhole; fund assets are custodied by State Street Bank and Trust, and NAV is computed daily using RedStone oracle data.
